findings.claim: Remaining Discord and Slack consumers must load Deliberation through the separately packaged public API/test contract rather than the retired bundled implementation.
findings.observed: The task checkpoint marks the package acquisition and three-loader migration incomplete; the supplied handoff inventory contains no public package contract or archive, and the owner-path consumers remain unable to load Deliberation.
findings.rationale: Retiring the bundled source without a runnable config-origin public package path leaves active host integration consumers coupled to an implementation that no longer exists, so the requested host decoupling is incomplete.
findings.required: Provide the pinned repo-local offline public package/test contract and migrate all three loaders to config-origin package resolution while preserving their existing scenarios and assertions.

findings.claim: The retirement deliverable must include assertion-level external-owner mapping and immutable proof for both transferred Slack root and child orchestration scenarios.
findings.observed: The supplied retirement checkpoint says the manifest has no dynamic target titles or target assertions and that two-case count parity does not establish preservation; the follow-up checkpoint marks acquisition of orchestration-assertion-map.json and expanded root/child proof incomplete.
findings.rationale: Without assertion-level mapping, the supplied material does not establish preservation of identity, bounded history, unrelated-thread exclusion, envelope and receipt invariants, send counts, and lifecycle behavior required by the task.
findings.required: Supply the owner-exported assertion map and immutable expanded root/child evidence covering every required scenario invariant.

findings.claim: This caller-declared TDD task requires a complete, ordered RED/GREEN proof for the follow-up repair.
findings.observed: The supplied TDD projection explicitly reports a missing GREEN phase and incomplete phase order; the task checkpoint likewise leaves focused GREEN capture incomplete.
findings.rationale: The manifest sets tddRequired to true, and a RED-only loader characterization does not demonstrate that the follow-up implementation reached GREEN.
findings.required: After delivering the repair, capture and supply the fresh GREEN phase linked to the valid historical or characterization RED, with complete phase ordering and provenance.
